scene.title: Visual Proof of the Pythagorean Theorem
scene.summary: A right triangle with squares on each side shows that the hypotenuse square area equals the sum of the leg squares.

beats.title: Draw triangle and squares
beats.narration: We draw a 3‑4‑5 right triangle and construct a square on each side.

beats.title: Label the areas
beats.narration: The squares have areas a², b² and c² respectively.

beats.title: Predict the relationship
beats.narration: What relationship do you expect between the three areas?

check.question: What is the relationship between the areas of the three squares?
check.explain: The Pythagorean theorem states exactly that the hypotenuse square equals the sum of the leg squares.

beats.title: Show the equality
beats.narration: Indeed, the area of the hypotenuse square equals the sum of the other two squares.

beats.title: Recap
beats.narration: Thus a² + b² = c², proved visually by the three squares on a right triangle.
